- [ES2004b:24:12] It was decided that the group will produce one product design instead of creating alternate designs in an attempt to accomodate different users' preferences.
- [ES2004b:22:42] The marketing will be focused towards a young, business-class buyer.
- [ES2004b:27:02] The remote will feature Video Plus capabilities and a seashell-like shape to accomodate the LCD display and the flip screen.
- [ES2004b:30:44] The remote will be bundled with a docking station to recharge the remote's batteries and a user-friendly instruction manual, and multiple casings will be made available. (replaces a remote without changeable covers)
- [ES2004c:32:41] It was decided that the remote would feature an LCD screen, rubber buttons, colorful rubber changeable skins, a kinetic battery, and possibly speech recognition if it is still within the budget to include it. (replaces a remote without a screen)
